2. INSPECT DIAGNOSIS (NORMAL MODE)
(a) Check the MIL.
(1) The MIL comes on when the ignition switch is turned
ON and the engine is not running.
HINT: C If the MIL does not light up, troubleshoot the combination meter
(See page BE-2).
(2) When the engine is started, the MIL should go off. CHECK If the lamp remains on, the diagnosis system has
detected a malfunction or abnormality in the sys­
tem.
(b) Check the DTC.
NOTICE:
TOYOTA hand-held tester only: When the diagnostic sys­
tem Is switched from normal mode to check mode, It erases
all OTCs and freeze frame data recorded in normal mode.
So before switching modes, always check the DTCs and
freeze frame data, and note them down.

J1978) or TOYOTA hand-held tester.
